title: Kyiv plans to connect all residential buildings to heating by November 12
summary: Heating supply to residential buildings in Kyiv began on November 2, and it will take 10 days to fully bring the heating system online.

title: Russia drones attack five districts of Dnipropetrovsk region overnight
summary: Russian forces carried out more than ten drone attacks against five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, causing damage to several locations.

title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure facility in Mykolaiv region
summary: Russian forces attacked an energy infrastructure facility in the Mykolaiv region yesterday using a Geran-type attack drone.

title: Russian army loses 2,440 troops in war against Ukraine over past day
summary: The total estimated combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 6, 2026, have reached approximately 1,601,830 personnel, including 2,440 troops lost over the past 24 hours.

title: Zelensky outlines main topics of negotiations between teams in Brussels
summary: Security guarantees for Ukraine and preparations for a trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi were the key topics of negotiations held in Brussels on November 4–5.

title: Ukraine to propose expanding Oleshky evacuation experience to other occupied territories in talks with U.S. and Russia – Zelensky
summary: Ukraine will propose to the United States and Russia that the evacuation efforts carried out in Oleshky be expanded to other occupied territories.

title: Canada to allocate $1.8B for drone procurement
summary: Canada will spend at least CAD 2.3 billion (approximately $1.8 billion) on deploying advanced combat drones and counter-drone systems.

title: Ukrainian citizen killed at hotel in Slovakia: Police open murder investigation
summary: A Ukrainian citizen died from stab wounds at a hotel in the western Slovak city of Trenčín during the night of November 5. Another Ukrainian citizen has been detained on suspicion of committing the crime.

title: Trump announces 'big deal' that concerns Ukraine and all of Europe
summary: The U.S. president said that a major agreement could be reached in the near future, one that would concern not only Ukraine but Europe as a whole.

title: Defense Forces neutralize more than 90% of Russian Lancet and Molniya drones in one week
summary: Russian forces deployed 7,947 Lancet and Molniya attack drones at the tactical level between October 29 and November 4. Ukraine's Defense Forces neutralized nearly 91% of them.

title: Prosecutor General's Office investigating deaths of 241 Ukrainians in Russian captivity
summary: Law enforcement officials are investigating 241 cases of Ukrainians dying in Russian captivity. The dead include 230 prisoners of war and 11 civilians.

title: Meloni urges EU to agree on representative for Ukraine peace talks
summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has called on the European Union to decide who will represent the bloc in negotiations on ending Russia's war against Ukraine and what mandate its representative will have.

title: Ukrainian troops capture Russian soldier wearing Ukrainian military uniform
summary: Operators of the 3rd Detachment of the 4th Ranger Regiment of the Special Operations Forces (SOF) captured a Russian serviceman who was disguised in a Ukrainian Armed Forces uniform.

title: Finland sentences Fitburg captain and boatswain to prison over damage to Gulf of Finland cables
summary: The Helsinki District Court has sentenced the captain and boatswain of the vessel Fitburg to prison terms in connection with damage to undersea cables in the Gulf of Finland late last year.

title: Clashes in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka: Police and Security Service identify 130 people who may be involved
summary: The National Police of Ukraine and the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) have identified 130 people who may have been involved in the unrest in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka.

title: UAH 15M bail posted for senior National Police official Tsenov in Carthage case
summary: Bail of UAH 15 million has been posted for Volodymyr Tsenov, First Deputy Head of the Strategic Investigations Department of the National Police.

title: Ukraine's Defense Ministry, Brave1 scale up EW-resistant group drone control technology
summary: Ukraine's Defense Ministry and the Brave1 defense innovation cluster are working to scale up a technology for controlling groups of unmanned aerial vehicles that allows drones to remain resistant to enemy electronic warfare (EW) systems.

title: Russian intelligence services recruiting Ukrainian refugees for sabotage operations in Europe – intelligence
summary: The recruitment of Ukrainians for hybrid operations in Europe is part of a systematic campaign aimed at convincing Europeans that supporting Ukraine is costing them too much.

title: Monaco assassination attempt on Yermolaiev: Lawyer reports searches at military intelligence officer's home
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) is conducting searches at the premises of an officer of the Ukrainian Defense Ministry's Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR) as part of an investigation into an attempted assassination of businessman Vadym Yermolaiev in Monaco.

title: Preparation for leaders' meeting, sectoral ceasefire: Ukraine outlines agenda for Abu Dhabi talks
summary: The Office of the President of Ukraine has outlined the issues that may be discussed during trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.

title: Russian forces strike several energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk region
summary: Russian forces struck several energy facilities in the Dnipropetrovsk region on the morning of November 6. The facilities had previously been targeted in Russian attacks.

title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian ammunition depots in Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk regions
summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck two Russian ammunition depots in the Zaporizhzhia region on November 5 and overnight into November 6, as well as an enemy drone command post and a fuel and lubricant depot in the Donetsk region.

title: Bodies of 53 people recovered from rubble of underground school in Komyshuvakha
summary: Search and rescue operations are continuing at the site of the November 2 airstrike in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. So far, rescuers have recovered the bodies of 53 people.

title: Russian forces attack energy facilities in Kirovohrad region
summary: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in the Kirovohrad region overnight and early on November 6.

title: Man killed in Russian morning attack on Rivne region, damage reported
summary: A man was killed in a Russian attack on the Sarny district, Rivne region, on Friday morning.

title: Five people injured in Russian drone attacks in Kyiv region over past day
summary: Five people were injured and a dormitory at an educational institution was damaged in Russian drone attacks in the Kyiv region over the past 24 hours.

title: Drones attack Afipsky Oil Refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai, fire breaks out – media
summary: On the night of Friday, November 6, a group of drones attacked the Afipsky Oil Refinery in Krasnodar Krai, southern Russia.

title: Russian night attack damages energy infrastructure in Kyiv region, three injured
summary: The consequences of a Russian overnight attack were reported in three districts of the Kyiv region, with three people injured.

title: ADF neutralizes 196 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 196 drones used by Russian forces to attack the country beginning on the evening of November 5.

title: War update: 188 combat engagements on front line over past day
summary: A total of 188 combat engagements took place between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian troops over the past 24 hours. Russian forces applied the greatest pressure in the Pokrovsk direction.
